aboutText: With over 30 years of experience, Cody Whelan Electrical Contractor has been serving Tullamarine and Melbourne's north with expert electrical services. Our team is committed to strong values and exceeding client needs, ensuring every job from residential to commercial is done right. We pride ourselves on reliability, safety, and customer satisfaction, making us a trusted choice for all electrical work.
servicesText: We provide comprehensive electrical solutions including residential and commercial installations, LED lighting upgrades, and specialized services like light towers and public displays. Our 24/7 availability ensures we're there when you need us, and our satisfaction guarantee covers all work.
